functional_spec:
Implement a synthesizable synchronous circular FIFO in SystemVerilog.
Parameters:
  DATA_WIDTH = 8
  DEPTH = 8
Ports:
  input  wire                  clk
  input  wire                  rst_n
  input  wire                  wr_en
  input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wr_data
  input  wire                  rd_en
  output reg  [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rd_data
  output wire                  full
  output wire                  empty
  output wire [3:0]            count
Behavior:
  Reset rst_n=0 clears count to 0, empty=1, full=0.
  Write: when wr_en && !full, write wr_data into memory and increment count.
  Read: when rd_en && !empty, read oldest data into rd_data and decrement count.
  Simultaneous read and write when not empty and not full: writes new data, reads oldest data, count remains unchanged.
  When full, ignore writes unless a valid read occurs simultaneously.
  When empty, ignore reads.
expected_behavior: Strict first-in-first-out delivery, accurate full/empty generation, overflow/underflow protection.
verification_strategy: Cycle simulation: fill to full, overflow attempt, drain to empty, underflow attempt, simultaneous rw + SBY BMC.
generation_prompt:
Write a synthesizable synchronous circular FIFO in SystemVerilog.
Module name: sync_fifo
Parameters: DATA_WIDTH = 8, DEPTH = 8
Ports:
  input  wire                  clk,
  input  wire                  rst_n,
  input  wire                  wr_en,
  input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wr_data,
  input  wire                  rd_en,
  output reg  [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rd_data,
  output wire                  full,
  output wire                  empty,
  output wire [3:0]            count
Requirements:
- Circular pointer or counter implementation.
- empty = (count == 0), full = (count == DEPTH).
- Ignore writes when full, ignore reads when empty.
- Support simultaneous read and write.
Output only SystemVerilog code inside ```systemverilog ... ```.
repair_policy: Maximum 3 repair turns; inject raw compiler/simulator diagnostics into prompt.
